scope.projectDisabledTooltip: Open a project to use project settings

uiLanguage.label: Interface Language
uiLanguage.description: Language for the app interface, independent of Claude's response language.

useCtrlEnterToSend.label: Use {{modifier}}+Enter To Send
useCtrlEnterToSend.description: When enabled, use Ctrl/Cmd+Enter to send prompts instead of just Enter. This allows Enter to create new lines.

attachEditorContext.label: Attach the editor file by default
attachEditorContext.description: Start each session with the open file or selection attached. Turn this off and the chip still appears, but starts switched off — click it to attach for that session.

focusInputOnEditorContext.label: Focus chat input after attaching file path
focusInputOnEditorContext.description: When you press Alt+K in the editor, move focus to the chat input after inserting the file path.

respectGitignore.label: Respect .gitignore for editor context
respectGitignore.description: When on, contents of .gitignore'd files are excluded from the editor context — only the file path is sent.

openSettings.label: Open Settings as
openSettings.description: Show Settings as an overlay or in a new tab.

chatPagination.label: Paginate chat history
chatPagination.description: Load older messages as you scroll. Off loads the whole conversation at once.

configDir.description: Home directory for Claude's config. Same as the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR environment variable.
configDir.projectUnavailable: Open a project to set a project value.

fileSuggestion.description: Custom command that builds the @ file index. Same as the fileSuggestion setting in settings.json.

autoResumeOnLimit.label: Auto-resume on usage limit
autoResumeOnLimit.description: When you hit your session limit, automatically resume once the quota resets. This is the default for new sessions; each session can still toggle it.

colorTheme.label: Color Theme
colorTheme.description: Choose the color theme for the interface

fontSize.label: Font Size
fontSize.description: Base font size for the interface

lineSpacing.label: Line Spacing
lineSpacing.description: Line height for chat message text

autoScrollThreshold.label: Auto-scroll resume distance
autoScrollThreshold.description: Scrolling further than this many pixels from the bottom pauses auto-scroll so you can read freely. It resumes once you scroll back within that distance. Smaller means you must return closer to re-engage. Default {{value}}.

sendUsageStatistics.label: Send usage statistics
sendUsageStatistics.description: Sends usage statistics that do not directly identify you, to help improve the product. Source code and personal data are never sent. You can turn this off anytime.

receiveAnnouncements.label: Receive announcements
receiveAnnouncements.description: Get in-app announcements about new features, tips, and important updates.
receiveAnnouncements.confirmMessage: Turning this off means you won't receive important messages either, including urgent patches and required updates. Turn it off anyway?

bypassMode.label: Disable Bypass Mode
bypassMode.description: Prevent bypass permissions mode from being activated

defaultMode.label: Default Input Mode
defaultMode.description: Initial permission mode when opening a new session

cliUpdate.confirmMessage: Updating replaces the Claude Code CLI and may interrupt running sessions. Continue?

sound.label: Sound
sound.description: Sound played when a desktop notification fires. Selecting a sound previews it once.
sound.emptyDescription: No system sounds detected. Select Off to silence notifications.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.revokeHint: To revoke, change in your browser settings.

connection.title: Connection

enable.label: Remote Tunnel (Unofficial)
enable.description: Expose your local server via cloudflared for remote access. No account required. If cloudflared isn’t installed, you’ll be asked to install it first.

connection.estimatedTime: This typically takes ~1 min (If installation is required, it takes about 3 mins.)
connection.pairingHint: Scan to link a device. The QR carries a one-time code that expires shortly — regenerate it if it stops working.

sleepPrevention.title: Sleep Prevention
sleepPrevention.label: Prevent Sleep
sleepPrevention.description: Keep your machine awake while the tunnel is active, even with the lid closed.

openFilesWith.title: Open files with
openFilesWith.label: Open files with
openFilesWith.description: Which program opens a file reference clicked in chat.
openFilesWith.jetbrainsDescription: Files open in your connected IDE.

app.label: Terminal App
app.description: Terminal application used when running 'Open Claude in Terminal'
app.jetbrainsDescription: JetBrains IDE built-in terminal is always used.

path.title: Claude CLI
path.label: CLI Path
path.description: Path to Claude CLI executable (leave empty for auto-detect)

nodePath.title: Node.js
nodePath.label: Node Path
nodePath.description: Path to Node.js executable that runs the backend (leave empty for auto-detect). Takes effect after restart.

notInstalled.title: A required dependency
notInstalled.description: Due to marketplace policy, this feature cannot be bundled in. It is published as a separate library that you need to install yourself.
notInstalled.retryHint: After installing, click Retry below — no IDE restart needed.

sponsor.title: Support this project
description: For the sustainable development of this independent project,
if you feel like it, please buy me a beer.
promises: Unlimited access to every sponsor-only feature
The top tier — no higher paid tier, ever
Even if the sponsorship amount rises for new sponsors, your amount stays the same

activate.title: Already a sponsor?
activate.description: Enter your sponsor key to activate sponsorship on this device.
activate.invalid: That key isn't valid. Please check it and try again.

active.title: Sponsoring
active.description: Thank you for supporting Claude Code with GUI.
active.promise: We will repay you with updates that are steadier, faster and more capable.

manage.clearKeyConfirmMessage: This device stops using sponsor features. Your sponsorship and billing are untouched — paste the key back any time to restore it.
manage.clearKeyDone: Sponsor key cleared on this device.
manage.cancelConfirmMessage: Billing stops at the end of the period you already paid for, and sponsor features keep working until then.
manage.cancelFailed: Could not cancel. Please try again in a moment.

benefits.title: Feature benefits
benefits.description: Features your sponsorship supports. Open one to read what it does.

devices.title: Active devices
devices.description: Machines where your sponsor key is in use.
devices.note: Sponsorship applies per key, not per account. An account is only used to verify the key — it is enough that the device has an account that may use it.
devices.removeConfirmMessage: The device stops being listed here. Your sponsor key stays valid, and the device reactivates the next time it is used.

billing.title: Payments
billing.description: Your payment history. Receipts open at the payment provider.

sponsor.letterToggle: Why are you asking for sponsorship?
letter: I'm an indie developer, and a longtime JetBrains user.
On VS Code you can use Claude Code through a GUI,
but JetBrains had nothing like it —
so I started building it myself, as an indie project.
As it found an audience, requests piled up
and the plugin took more and more of my time,
until I started wishing I could go independent and focus on it fully.
To answer fellow developers around the world faster,
and to make this a project that can sustain itself,
sponsor.openSourceNote: The core of this project remains open source, and every community feature stays available to everyone, sponsor or not.
